claims: ClaudeKit is best for normal marketing/website pages; UI UX Pro Max is the one to use for app UI
Superpowers is 'by far the coolest skill I've ever downloaded'; if you install only one, pick Superpowers
Addy Osmani's agent-skills is similar to Superpowers but covers the whole SDLC from ideation through development, testing and migration
how_to_steps: Install ClaudeKit skills for marketing/landing pages
Install UI UX Pro Max and invoke it while building app screens
Install Superpowers and use its brainstorm feature (pops up a browser to walk through design choices) before building features
Optionally trial addyosmani/agent-skills for an end-to-end engineering workflow
